description: Get one sweep: its members, which of them launched, the hosts they landed on, and whether their environments are byte-identical. Use after create_image_sweep to see whether the members agree, and to find which field differs when they do not — the verdict names the differing keys rather than only reporting a mismatch. A member that never reported a fingerprint is unknown, never counted as agreeing. Read-only and free.
name: get_image_sweep
